sentences.zh: 時侯嬴在旁，曰：「人固未易知，知人亦未易也。

translations.literal: At time Hou Ying at side, said: 'Person certainly not easy know, know person also not easy.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Hou Ying was at the side, saying: 'People are certainly not easy to know, and knowing people is also not easy.

sentences.zh: 夫虞卿躡屩檐簦，一見趙王，賜白璧一雙，黃金百鎰；

translations.literal: Yu Qing stepped shoes eaves hat, one see Zhao Wang, granted white jade one pair, yellow gold hundred yi;
translations.idiomatic: Yu Qing stepped in shoes and wore an eaves hat, one meeting with the King of Zhao, granted a pair of white jade disks, one hundred yi of yellow gold;

sentences.zh: 再見，拜為上卿；

translations.literal: Two see, appointed upper minister;
translations.idiomatic: Second meeting, appointed as upper minister;

sentences.zh: 三見，卒受相印，封萬戶侯。

translations.literal: Three see, finally received chancellor seal, sealed ten thousand household hou.
translations.idiomatic: Third meeting, finally received the chancellor seal, sealed as ten thousand household hou.

sentences.zh: 當此之時，天下爭知之。

translations.literal: At this time, world contended know him.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, the world contended to know him.

sentences.zh: 夫魏齊窮困過虞卿，虞卿不敢重爵祿之尊，解相印，捐萬戶侯而閒行。

translations.literal: Wei Qi poor distressed passed Yu Qing, Yu Qing dared not heavy rank salary honor, untied chancellor seal, abandoned ten thousand household hou hidden walk.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Qi's poverty and distress surpassed Yu Qing's, yet Yu Qing dared not value the honor of rank and salary, untied his chancellor seal, abandoned his ten thousand household hou status and traveled in secret.

sentences.zh: 急士之窮而歸公子，公子曰『何如人』。

translations.literal: Urgent scholar poor returned crown prince, crown prince said 'what like person'.
translations.idiomatic: When a scholar in urgent poverty returned to the crown prince, the crown prince said 'What kind of person is he?'

sentences.zh: 人固不易知，知人亦未易也！」

translations.literal: Person certainly not easy know, know person also not easy!'
translations.idiomatic: People are certainly not easy to know, and knowing people is also not easy!'

sentences.zh: 信陵君大慚，駕如野迎之。

translations.literal: Xinling Jun greatly ashamed, drove like wild welcomed him.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Xinling was greatly ashamed, drove wildly to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 魏齊聞信陵君之初難見之，怒而自剄。

translations.literal: Wei Qi heard Xinling Jun initial difficult see him, angered self cut throat.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Qi heard that Lord Xinling initially found it difficult to see him, became angry and cut his own throat.

sentences.zh: 趙王聞之，卒取其頭予秦。

translations.literal: Zhao Wang heard, finally took head gave Qin.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Zhao heard this and finally took his head and gave it to Qin.

sentences.zh: 秦昭王乃出平原君歸趙。

translations.literal: Qin Zhao Wang then out Ping Yuan Jun returned Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: King Zhao of Qin then let Lord Pingyuan out to return to Zhao.

sentences.zh: 昭王四十三年，秦攻韓汾陘，拔之，因城河上廣武。

translations.literal: Zhao Wang forty three year, Qin attacked Han Fen Xing, captured, because walled river upper Guang Wu.
translations.idiomatic: In King Zhao's forty-third year, Qin attacked Han's Fenxing, captured it, and thus walled Guangwu on the upper river.

sentences.zh: 後五年，昭王用應侯謀，縱反閒賣趙，趙以其故，令馬服子代廉頗將。

translations.literal: Later five years, Zhao Wang used Ying Hou plan, released rebel spies sold Zhao, Zhao because sent Ma Fu Zi replace Lian Po general.
translations.idiomatic: Five years later, King Zhao used Ying Hou's plan, released rebel spies to sell Zhao, and Zhao because of this sent Ma Fu Zi to replace Lian Po as general.

sentences.zh: 秦大破趙於長平，遂圍邯鄲。

translations.literal: Qin greatly broke Zhao at Chang Ping, then surrounded Handan.
translations.idiomatic: Qin greatly broke Zhao at Changping, then surrounded Handan.

sentences.zh: 已而與武安君白起有隙，言而殺之。

translations.literal: Already with Wu An Jun Bai Qi had gap, spoke killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, he had a rift with Lord Wu'an Bai Qi, spoke against him, and had him killed.

sentences.zh: 任鄭安平，使擊趙。

translations.literal: Entrusted Zheng Anping, made attack Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: He entrusted Zheng Anping with command and sent him to attack Zhao.

sentences.zh: 鄭安平為趙所圍，急，以兵二萬人降趙。

translations.literal: Zheng Anping by Zhao surrounded, urgent, with troops twenty thousand surrendered Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Anping was surrounded by Zhao and, in desperate straits, surrendered to Zhao with twenty thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 應侯席槁請罪。

translations.literal: Ying Hou straw mat begged crime.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ying sat on straw and begged for punishment.

sentences.zh: 秦之法，任人而所任不善者，各以其罪罪之。

translations.literal: Qin law, entrust person yet entrusted not good, each with crime punish him.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qin law, when someone recommends a man and the man recommended proves bad, the recommender is punished for the same offense.

sentences.zh: 於是應侯罪當收三族。

translations.literal: Then Ying Hou crime should confiscate three clans.
translations.idiomatic: Thus, Lord Ying's crime should confiscate the three clans.

sentences.zh: 秦昭王恐傷應侯之意，乃下令國中：「有敢言鄭安平事者，以其罪罪之。」

translations.literal: Qin Zhao Wang feared injure Ying Hou intent, then issued order state middle: 'Have dare speak Zheng Anping matter, with crime punish him.'
translations.idiomatic: King Zhao of Qin feared harming Lord Ying's intentions, so he issued an order throughout the state: 'Anyone who dares to speak of Zheng Anping's affairs will be punished with the same crime.'

sentences.zh: 而加賜相國應侯食物日益厚，以順適其意。

translations.literal: And he increased the food and goods bestowed on Chancellor Lord Ying day by day, making them more generous in order to accord with his wishes.
translations.idiomatic: He also increased the food and goods granted to Chancellor Lord Ying, making the gifts more generous each day to suit his wishes.

sentences.zh: 後二歲，王稽為河東守，與諸侯通，坐法誅。

translations.literal: Later two years, Wang Ji as Hedong guard, with various lords communicate, sat law executed.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later, Wang Ji as Hedong guard communicated with the various lords, sat under the law and was executed.

sentences.zh: 而應侯日益以不懌。

translations.literal: Yet Ying Hou increasingly not pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Lord Ying increasingly was displeased.

sentences.zh: 昭王臨朝嘆息，應侯進曰：「臣聞『主憂臣辱，主辱臣死』。

translations.literal: King Zhao faced the court and sighed; Lord Ying advanced and said: 'Your servant has heard that when the lord worries, the minister is shamed; when the lord is shamed, the minister dies.
translations.idiomatic: King Zhao faced the court and sighed; Lord Ying advanced and said: 'I have heard that when the lord worries, the minister is shamed; when the lord is shamed, the minister dies.

sentences.zh: 今大王中朝而憂，臣敢請其罪。」

translations.literal: Now great king middle court worry, minister dare request crime.'
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty worries in the middle of court, I dare request my crime.'

sentences.zh: 昭王曰：「吾聞楚之鐵劍利而倡優拙。

translations.literal: Zhao Wang said: 'I heard Chu iron sword sharp yet actors clumsy.
translations.idiomatic: King Zhao said: 'I have heard that Chu's iron swords are sharp yet their actors are clumsy.

sentences.zh: 夫鐵劍利則士勇，倡優拙則思慮遠。

translations.literal: Iron sword sharp then scholars brave, actors clumsy then thoughts far.
translations.idiomatic: When iron swords are sharp then scholars are brave, when actors are clumsy then thoughts are far.

sentences.zh: 夫以遠思慮而御勇士，吾恐楚之圖秦也。

translations.literal: With far thoughts govern brave scholars, I fear Chu plan Qin.
translations.idiomatic: With far-reaching thoughts to govern brave scholars, I fear Chu plans against Qin.

sentences.zh: 夫物不素具，不可以應卒，今武安君既死，而鄭安平等畔，內無良將而外多敵國，吾是以憂。」

translations.literal: Things not prepared, not can respond suddenly, now Wu An Jun already died, Zheng Anping etc rebelled, inner no good general outer many enemy states, I thus worry.'
translations.idiomatic: Things not prepared in advance cannot respond to emergencies, now Lord Wu'an has already died, and Zheng Anping and others have rebelled, within there are no good generals and without there are many enemy states, this is why I worry.'

sentences.zh: 欲以激勵應侯。

translations.literal: Wished stimulate encourage Ying Hou.
translations.idiomatic: Wished to stimulate and encourage Lord Ying.

sentences.zh: 應侯懼，不知所出。

translations.literal: Ying Hou feared, not knew what out.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ying feared, did not know what to do.

sentences.zh: 蔡澤聞之，往入秦也。

translations.literal: Cai Ze heard, went entered Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ze heard this and went to enter Qin.

sentences.zh: 蔡澤者，燕人也。

translations.literal: Cai Ze, Yan person.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ze was a Yan person.

sentences.zh: 游學干諸侯小大甚眾，不遇。

translations.literal: He traveled for study and sought service from many lords, great and small, but did not meet with success.
translations.idiomatic: He traveled in search of learning and office, appealing to many lords great and small, but found no patron.

sentences.zh: 而從唐舉相，曰：「吾聞先生相李兌，曰『百日之內持國秉』，有之乎？」

translations.literal: Followed Tang Ju chancellor, said: 'I heard master divined Li Kui, said 'hundred days within hold state authority', have it?'
translations.idiomatic: He followed Tang Ju the chancellor and said: 'I have heard that Master divined for Li Kui, saying "within a hundred days he will hold the state's authority", is this true?'

sentences.zh: 曰：「有之。」

translations.literal: Said: 'Have.'
translations.idiomatic: He said: 'It is.'

sentences.zh: 曰：「若臣者何如？」

translations.literal: Said: 'Like minister what?'
translations.idiomatic: He said: 'What about one like me?'

sentences.zh: 唐舉孰視而笑曰：「先生曷鼻，巨肩，魋顏，蹙齃，膝攣。

translations.literal: Tang Ju carefully observed laughed: 'Master what nose, great shoulders, snub face, wrinkled teeth, bent knees.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Ju looked him over carefully and laughed, saying: 'Master, you have a broad nose, great shoulders, a snub face, a wrinkled nose, and bent knees.

sentences.zh: 吾聞聖人不相，殆先生乎？」

translations.literal: I have heard that sages are not read by physiognomy; perhaps that is you, Master?"
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that sages cannot be judged by physiognomy. Perhaps that is true of you, Master?"

sentences.zh: 蔡澤知唐舉戲之，乃曰：「富貴吾所自有，吾所不知者壽也，願聞之。」

translations.literal: Cai Ze knew Tang Ju played him, then said: 'Rich noble I self have, I not know longevity, wish hear it.'
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ze knew that Tang Ju was playing with him, then said: 'Richness and nobility I possess myself, what I do not know is longevity, I wish to hear of it.'

sentences.zh: 唐舉曰：「先生之壽，從今以往者四十三歲。」

translations.literal: Tang Ju said: 'Master longevity, from now future forty three years.'
translations.idiomatic: Tang Ju said: 'Master's longevity, from now going forward, is forty-three years.'

sentences.zh: 蔡澤笑謝而去，謂其御者曰：「吾持粱刺齒肥，躍馬疾驅，懷黃金之印，結紫綬於要，揖讓人主之前，食肉富貴，四十三年足矣。」

translations.literal: Cai Ze laughed thanked left, told charioteer: 'I hold liang skewer teeth fat, leap horse swift drive, embrace yellow gold seal, tie purple ribbon waist, bow yield person lord before, eat meat rich noble, forty three years sufficient.'
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ze laughed, thanked him, and left, telling his charioteer: 'I will hold millet skewered for my teeth while the meat is fat, leap on my horse and drive swiftly, embrace the golden seal, tie the purple ribbon at my waist, bow, and yield before the lord of men, eat meat in wealth and honor—forty-three years is enough.'

sentences.zh: 去之趙，見逐。

translations.literal: Left Zhao, saw drove.
translations.idiomatic: He went to Zhao and was driven away.

sentences.zh: 之韓、魏，遇奪釜鬲於涂。

translations.literal: Went Han, Wei, met robbed pot tripod on road.
translations.idiomatic: Went to Han and Wei, met with robbery of pots and tripods on the road.

sentences.zh: 聞應侯任鄭安平、王稽皆負重罪於秦，應侯內慚，蔡澤乃西入秦。

translations.literal: Heard Ying Hou entrusted Zheng Anping, Wang Ji all bore heavy crime at Qin, Ying Hou inner ashamed, Cai Ze then west entered Qin.
translations.idiomatic: Heard that Ying Hou had entrusted Zheng Anping and Wang Ji, both of whom bore heavy crimes in Qin, Ying Hou was internally ashamed, and Cai Ze then went west to enter Qin.

sentences.zh: 將見昭王，使人宣言以感怒應侯曰：「燕客蔡澤，天下雄俊弘辯智士也。

translations.literal: Before seeing King Zhao, he had people spread words to provoke Lord Ying, saying, "Cai Ze, a guest from Yan, is a bold, outstanding, broadly eloquent, and wise scholar of the world.
translations.idiomatic: Before his audience with King Zhao, Cai Ze had people spread a report to provoke Lord Ying: "Cai Ze, a visitor from Yan, is a formidable, eloquent, and brilliant scholar of the age.

sentences.zh: 彼一見秦王，秦王必困君而奪君之位。」

translations.literal: Once he meets the King of Qin, the King of Qin will certainly put you in difficulty and take your position."
translations.idiomatic: Once he meets the King of Qin, the king will surely set you aside and take away your post."

sentences.zh: 應侯聞，曰：「五帝三代之事，百家之說，吾既知之，眾口之辯，吾皆摧之，是惡能困我而奪我位乎？」

translations.literal: Ying Hou heard, said: 'Five emperors three dynasties matters, hundred schools sayings, I already know, crowds mouths debate, I all crushed, how able distress me seize position?'
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ying heard and said: 'Matters of the five emperors and three dynasties, sayings of the hundred schools, I already know them all, debates of crowds' mouths, I have crushed them all—how could he distress me and seize my position?'

sentences.zh: 使人召蔡澤。

translations.literal: Made people summoned Cai Ze.
translations.idiomatic: He had people summon Cai Ze.

sentences.zh: 蔡澤入，則揖應。

translations.literal: Cai Ze entered, bowed Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ze entered and bowed to Ying.

sentences.zh: 應侯固不快，及見之，又倨，應侯因讓之曰：「子嘗宣言欲代我相秦，寧有之乎？」

translations.literal: Lord Ying was already displeased, and when Cai Ze saw him he was again arrogant, so Lord Ying reproached him, saying, "You once proclaimed that you wished to replace me as Qin's chancellor. Is there such a thing?"
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ying was already unhappy; when Cai Ze met him, Cai Ze behaved arrogantly as well. Lord Ying rebuked him: "You have been saying that you mean to replace me as chancellor of Qin. Is that true?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「然。」

translations.literal: Replied: 'Yes.'
translations.idiomatic: He replied: 'Yes.'

sentences.zh: 應侯曰：「請聞其說。」

translations.literal: Ying Hou said: 'Please hear saying.'
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ying said: 'Please hear the reasoning.'

sentences.zh: 蔡澤曰：「吁，君何見之晚也！

translations.literal: Cai Ze said: 'Alas, jun what see late!
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ze said: 'Alas, why has Your Lordship seen this so late!

sentences.zh: 夫四時之序，成功者去。

translations.literal: Four seasons sequence, successful leave.
translations.idiomatic: The sequence of the four seasons—successful ones depart.

sentences.zh: 夫人生百體堅彊，手足便利，耳目聰明而心聖智，豈非士之願與？」

translations.literal: Person life hundred body firm strong, hands feet convenient, ears eyes intelligent heart sage wise, how not scholar wish with?
translations.idiomatic: For a person to live with all his limbs firm and strong, hands and feet nimble, ears and eyes sharp, and mind sagely and wise—is this not what a scholar desires?'

sentences.zh: 應侯曰：「然。」

translations.literal: Ying Hou said: 'Yes.'
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ying said: 'Yes.'

sentences.zh: 蔡澤曰：「質仁秉義，行道施德，得志於天下，天下懷樂敬愛而尊慕之，皆願以為君王，豈不辯智之期與？」

translations.literal: Cai Ze said: 'Substantial benevolence grasp righteousness, walk way apply virtue, get will at world, world cherish happy revere love honor admire, all wish as lord king, how not eloquent wise period with?
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ze said: 'Substantial benevolence grasping righteousness, walking the way and applying virtue, getting will in the world, the world cherishing happiness revering loving honoring admiring it, all wishing to make it lord and king—is this not the period of eloquence and wisdom?'

sentences.zh: 應侯曰：「然。」

translations.literal: Ying Hou said: 'Yes.'
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ying said: 'Yes.'

sentences.zh: 蔡澤復曰：「富貴顯榮，成理萬物，使各得其所；

translations.literal: Cai Ze again said: 'Rich noble illustrious honored, complete principle ten thousand things, make each get place;
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ze again said: 'Richness nobility illustrious honor, completing the principle of ten thousand things, making each get their place;

sentences.zh: 性命壽長，終其天年而不夭傷；

translations.literal: Life and longevity long, ending their heaven-allotted years without premature injury;
translations.idiomatic: Life and longevity long, ending their natural span without premature injury;

sentences.zh: 天下繼其統，守其業，傳之無窮；

translations.literal: The world continues their line, preserves their achievements, and transmits them without end;
translations.idiomatic: All under Heaven carries on their line, preserves their achievements, and passes them down without end;

sentences.zh: 名實純粹，澤流千里，世世稱之而無絕，與天地終始：豈道德之符而聖人所謂吉祥善事者與？」

translations.literal: name and reality are pure, beneficence flows a thousand li, generations praise them without ceasing, and they last from beginning to end with Heaven and Earth: is this not the token of the Way and virtue, and what the sages called an auspicious good thing?"
translations.idiomatic: their name and substance are pure, their grace flows for a thousand li, and generation after generation praises them without end, lasting with Heaven and Earth. Is this not the sign of the Way and virtue, what the sages called an auspicious good?"

sentences.zh: 應侯曰：「然。」

translations.literal: Ying Hou said: 'Yes.'
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ying said: 'Yes.'

sentences.zh: 蔡澤曰：「若夫秦之商君，楚之吳起，越之大夫種，其卒然亦可願與？」

translations.literal: Cai Ze said: 'If Qin Shang Jun, Chu Wu Qi, Yue Da Fu Zhong, their end also can wish with?
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ze said: 'As for Qin's Shang Jun, Chu's Wu Qi, Yue's Da Fu Zhong—their ends, can they also be wished for?'

sentences.zh: 應侯知蔡澤之欲困己以說，復謬曰：「何為不可？

translations.literal: Ying Hou knew Cai Ze wished distress self with persuasion, again deliberately said: 'What not possible?
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ying knew that Cai Ze wished to distress him with persuasion, and again deliberately said: 'Why not possible?

sentences.zh: 夫公孫鞅之事孝公也，極身無貳慮，盡公而不顧私；

translations.literal: In Gongsun Yang's service to Duke Xiao, he exerted his person without divided thoughts and exhausted the public without regard for the private;
translations.idiomatic: In Gongsun Yang's service to Duke Xiao, he exerted himself without divided thoughts and exhausted the public without regard for the private;

sentences.zh: 設刀鋸以禁姦邪，信賞罰以致治；

translations.literal: He established knife and saw to prohibit treachery and evil, and trusted rewards and punishments to bring about order;
translations.idiomatic: He used the knife and saw to restrain treachery and evil, and relied on rewards and punishments to bring order;

sentences.zh: 披腹心，示情素，蒙怨咎，欺舊友，奪魏公子卬，安秦社稷，利百姓，卒為秦禽將破敵，攘地千里。

translations.literal: Expose abdomen heart, show true feelings, bear resentment blame, deceive old friends, seize Wei crown prince Ang, secure Qin altars soil, benefit hundred surnames, finally for Qin capture general break enemy, expand land thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: He exposed his innermost thoughts, showed his true feelings, bore resentment and blame, deceived old friends, seized Wei's Crown Prince Ang, secured Qin's altars and soil, benefited the hundred surnames, and finally for Qin captured generals broke enemies, expanded land a thousand li.

sentences.zh: 吳起之事悼王也，使私不得害公，讒不得蔽忠，言不取茍合，行不取茍容，不為危易行，行義不辟難，然為霸主彊國，不辭禍凶。

translations.literal: When Wu Qi served King Dao, he made private interests unable to harm the public, slander unable to obscure loyalty, speech not seek careless agreement, conduct not seek careless acceptance, did not change conduct because of danger, practiced righteousness without avoiding difficulty, and thus made a hegemon lord and strong state, not declining calamity or danger.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Qi served King Dao, he did not let private interest injure the public good or slander obscure loyalty. His words did not chase easy agreement, his conduct did not seek easy acceptance, he did not alter his course in danger, and he did not avoid hardship when righteousness required it. In this way he made his ruler a hegemon and his state strong, accepting disaster and peril without shrinking.

sentences.zh: 大夫種之事越王也，主雖困辱，悉忠而不解，主雖絕亡，盡能而弗離，成功而弗矜，貴富而不驕怠。

translations.literal: Da Fu Zhong's service to King Yue: though his lord was distressed and humiliated, he remained completely loyal without slackening. Though his lord was severed and perished, he exhausted his abilities without leaving. When successful, he was not arrogant; when noble and rich, he was not proud and indolent.
translations.idiomatic: Da Fu Zhong's service to the King of Yue: though his lord was distressed and humiliated, he was completely loyal without slackening, though his lord was severed and perished, he exhausted his abilities without leaving, successful without arrogance, noble and rich without pride and indolence.

sentences.zh: 若此三子者，固義之至也，忠之節也。

translations.literal: Like this three persons, certainly righteousness extreme, loyal principle.
translations.idiomatic: Like these three persons, certainly the extreme of righteousness, the principle of loyalty.

sentences.zh: 是故君子以義死難，視死如歸；

translations.literal: Thus, gentleman with righteousness die difficulty, view death as return;
translations.idiomatic: Thus, the gentleman dies difficulties with righteousness, views death as returning home;

sentences.zh: 生而辱不如死而榮。

translations.literal: Live humiliated not equal die honored.
translations.idiomatic: Living humiliated is not equal to dying honored.

sentences.zh: 士固有殺身以成名，雖義之所在，雖死無所恨。

translations.literal: Scholar certainly have kill body complete name, though righteousness location, though die no regret.
translations.idiomatic: A scholar may indeed sacrifice his body to complete his name. If righteousness lies there, then even in death he has no regret.

sentences.zh: 何為不可哉？」

translations.literal: What not possible?'
translations.idiomatic: What makes it impossible?'

sentences.zh: 蔡澤曰：「主聖臣賢，天下之盛福也；

translations.literal: Jun enlightened minister straight, state fortune;
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ze said: 'Lord sage minister worthy, world's great fortune;

sentences.zh: 君明臣直，國之福也；

translations.literal: Lord enlightened minister upright, state fortune;
translations.idiomatic: Lord enlightened minister upright, state's fortune;

sentences.zh: 父慈子孝，夫信妻貞，家之福也。

translations.literal: Father kind son filial, husband faithful wife chaste, family fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Father kind son filial, husband faithful wife chaste, family's fortune.

sentences.zh: 故比干忠而不能存殷，子胥智而不能完吳，申生孝而晉國亂。

translations.literal: Thus, Bi Gan loyal yet cannot preserve Yin, Zi Xu wise yet cannot complete Wu, Shen Sheng filial yet Jin state chaotic.
translations.idiomatic: Thus, Bi Gan loyal yet could not preserve Yin, Zi Xu wise yet could not complete Wu, Shen Sheng filial yet Jin state chaotic.

sentences.zh: 是皆有忠臣孝子，而國家滅亂者，何也？

translations.literal: These all have loyal minister filial son, yet state extinguish chaotic, why?
translations.idiomatic: These all had loyal ministers and filial sons, yet the states extinguished and were chaotic—what is the reason?

sentences.zh: 無明君賢父以聽之，故天下以其君父為僇辱而憐其臣子。

translations.literal: No enlightened lord worthy father to listen, thus world with lord father as humiliated pity minister son.
translations.idiomatic: No enlightened lord or worthy father to listen to them, thus the world humiliates their lords and fathers and pities their ministers and sons.

sentences.zh: 今商君、吳起、大夫種之為人臣，是也；

translations.literal: Now Shang Jun, Wu Qi, Da Fu Zhong as person minister, is;
translations.idiomatic: Now as for Shang Jun, Wu Qi, Da Fu Zhong being ministers, they were right;

sentences.zh: 其君，非也。

translations.literal: Their lords were wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Their lords, were wrong.

sentences.zh: 故世稱三子致功而不見德，豈慕不遇世死乎？

translations.literal: Thus, world praise three persons achieve merit not see virtue, how wish not meet world die?
translations.idiomatic: Thus, the world praises the three for achieving merit but does not see virtue—would they wish to not meet the world and die?

sentences.zh: 夫待死而後可以立忠成名，是微子不足仁，孔子不足聖，管仲不足大也。

translations.literal: To wait die then can establish loyal complete name, is Wei Zi insufficient benevolent, Confucius insufficient sage, Guan Zhong insufficient great.
translations.idiomatic: To wait for death and then establish loyalty and complete fame—this means Wei Zi was insufficiently benevolent, Confucius insufficiently sage, Guan Zhong insufficiently great.

sentences.zh: 夫人之立功，豈不期於成全邪？

translations.literal: Person establish merit, how not hope complete?
translations.idiomatic: A person's establishing merit, is it not hoped for completeness?

sentences.zh: 身與名俱全者，上也。

translations.literal: Body name together complete, upper.
translations.idiomatic: Body and name both complete—the highest.

sentences.zh: 名可法而身死者，其次也。

translations.literal: Name can model body die, next.
translations.idiomatic: Name can be modeled and body dies—the next.

sentences.zh: 名在僇辱而身全者，下也。」

translations.idiomatic: Name in humiliation and body complete—the lowest.'

sentences.zh: 於是應侯稱善。

translations.literal: Then Ying Hou praised good.
translations.idiomatic: At this, Lord Ying praised it as good.

sentences.zh: 蔡澤少得閒，因曰：「夫商君、吳起、大夫種，其為人臣盡忠致功則可願矣，閎夭事文王，周公輔成王也，豈不亦忠聖乎？

translations.literal: Cai Ze little get leisure, thus said: 'Shang Jun, Wu Qi, Da Fu Zhong, their as ministers exhaust loyal achieve merit then can wish, Hong Yao serve Wen Wang, Zhou Gong assist Cheng Wang also, how not also loyal sage?
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ze having a brief moment of leisure, thus said: 'As for Shang Jun, Wu Qi, Da Fu Zhong, their being ministers exhausting loyalty and achieving merit can certainly be wished for, Hong Yao serving King Wen, Zhou Gong assisting King Cheng—were they not also loyal and sage?

sentences.zh: 以君臣論之，商君、吳起、大夫種其可願孰與閎夭、周公哉？」

translations.literal: With jun chen discuss, Shang Jun, Wu Qi, Da Fu Zhong their can wish who with Hong Yao, Zhou Gong?'
translations.idiomatic: In terms of lord and minister, Shang Jun, Wu Qi, Da Fu Zhong—their being wished for, who compares to Hong Yao and Zhou Gong?'

sentences.zh: 應侯曰：「商君、吳起、大夫種弗若也。」

translations.literal: Ying Hou said: 'Shang Jun, Wu Qi, Da Fu Zhong not equal.'
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ying said: 'Shang Jun, Wu Qi, Da Fu Zhong do not compare.'

sentences.zh: 蔡澤曰：「然則君之主慈仁任忠，惇厚舊故，其賢智與有道之士為膠漆，義不倍功臣，孰與秦孝公、楚悼王、越王乎？」

translations.literal: Cai Ze said: 'Then jun lord kind benevolent employ loyal, sincere thick old acquaintance, worthy wise with have way scholars as glue lacquer, righteousness not double merit ministers, who with Qin Xiao Gong, Chu Dao Wang, Yue Wang?'
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ze said: 'In that case, is Your Lordship's ruler kinder and more benevolent, better at employing the loyal, more sincere and generous toward old acquaintances, more closely bonded with worthy, wise, and principled men, and less willing to betray meritorious ministers than Duke Xiao of Qin, King Dao of Chu, or the King of Yue?'

sentences.zh: 應侯曰：「未知何如也。」

translations.literal: Ying Hou said: 'Unknown what like.'
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ying said: 'I do not know how it compares.'

sentences.zh: 蔡澤曰：「今主親忠臣，不過秦孝公、楚悼王、越王，君之設智，能為主安危修政，治亂彊兵，批患折難，廣地殖穀，富國足家，彊主，尊社稷，顯宗廟，天下莫敢欺犯其主，主之威蓋震海內，功彰萬里之外，聲名光輝傳於千世，君孰與商君、吳起、大夫種？」

translations.literal: Cai Ze said: 'Now jun personally loyal ministers, not over Qin Xiao Gong, Chu Dao Wang, Yue Wang, jun establish wisdom, able for jun secure danger repair politics, govern chaos strong troops, ward off calamity break difficulty, broaden land plant grain, enrich state sufficient family, strong jun, honor altars soil, illustrious ancestral temple, world none dare deceive offend jun, jun might cover shake within seas, merit spread ten thousand li outside, sound name glory transmit thousand generations, jun who with Shang Jun, Wu Qi, Da Fu Zhong?'
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ze said: 'Now as for personally employing loyal ministers, not exceeding Duke Xiao of Qin, King Dao of Chu, King of Yue, Your Lordship's establishing wisdom, able to secure danger for the ruler, repair politics, govern chaos and strengthen troops, ward off calamity and break difficulties, broaden land and plant grain, enrich the state and suffice the family, strengthen the ruler, honor the altars and soil, illustrious the ancestral temple, the world none dare deceive or offend the ruler, the ruler's might covers and shakes within the seas, merit spreads ten thousand li beyond, sound and name glory transmit to a thousand generations—Your Lordship who compares to Shang Jun, Wu Qi, Da Fu Zhong?'

sentences.zh: 應侯曰：「不若。」

translations.literal: Ying Hou said: 'Not equal.'
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ying said: 'Not comparable.'

sentences.zh: 蔡澤曰：「今主之親忠臣不忘舊故不若孝公、悼王、句踐，而君之功績愛信親幸又不若商君、吳起、大夫種，然而君之祿位貴盛，私家之富過於三子，而身不退者，恐患之甚於三子，竊為君危之。

translations.literal: Cai Ze said: 'Now jun personally loyal ministers not forget old acquaintance not equal Xiao Gong, Dao Wang, Gou Jian, yet jun merit achievements love trust personal favor again not equal Shang Jun, Wu Qi, Da Fu Zhong, however jun salary position noble flourishing, private family rich over three persons, body not retreat, fear calamity over three persons, secretly for jun dangerous.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ze said: 'Now as for personally employing loyal ministers and not forgetting old acquaintances, not comparable to Duke Xiao, King Dao, Gou Jian, yet Your Lordship's merit achievements, love trust and personal favor again not comparable to Shang Jun, Wu Qi, Da Fu Zhong, however Your Lordship's salary and position noble and flourishing, private family's wealth exceeds the three, yet body not retreating—I fear the calamity will exceed the three, I secretly consider it dangerous for Your Lordship.

sentences.zh: 語曰『日中則移，月滿則虧』。

translations.literal: Sayings say 'sun middle then move, moon full then wane'.
translations.idiomatic: The saying goes 'when the sun reaches midday it shifts, when the moon is full it wanes'.

sentences.zh: 物盛則衰，天地之常數也。

translations.literal: Things flourishing then decline, heaven earth constant number.
translations.idiomatic: Things flourish then decline—this is the constant principle of heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 進退盈縮，與時變化，聖人之常道也。

translations.literal: Advance retreat full shrink, with time change, sage constant way.
translations.idiomatic: Advance and retreat, wax and wane, changing with time—this is the constant way of the sage.

sentences.zh: 故『國有道則仕，國無道則隱』。

translations.literal: Thus, 'state have way then serve, state no way then hide'.
translations.idiomatic: Thus, 'when the state has the way then serve, when the state has no way then hide'.

sentences.zh: 聖人曰『飛龍在天，利見大人』。

translations.literal: Sage said 'flying dragon heaven, benefit see adult'.
translations.idiomatic: The sage said 'flying dragon in heaven, benefit in seeing the great man'.

sentences.zh: 『不義而富且貴，於我如浮雲』。

translations.literal: 'Not righteous yet rich noble, to me like floating cloud'.
translations.idiomatic: 'Not righteous yet rich and noble—to me like floating clouds'.

sentences.zh: 今君之怨已讎而德已報，意欲至矣，而無變計，竊為君不取也。

translations.literal: Now jun resentments already avenge virtues already repay, intentions wish reach limit, yet no change plan, secretly for jun not take.
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Lordship's resentments have been avenged and virtues repaid, intentions have reached their limit, yet no change of plans—I secretly consider it unwise for Your Lordship.

sentences.zh: 且夫翠、鵠、犀、象，其處勢非不遠死也，而所以死者，惑於餌也。

translations.literal: Moreover, green pheasant, swan, rhino, elephant, place situation not far die, yet what die, confused by bait.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the green pheasant, swan, rhino, elephant—their positions were not far from death, yet the reason they died was confusion from bait.

sentences.zh: 蘇秦、智伯之智，非不足以辟辱遠死也，而所以死者，惑於貪利不止也。

translations.literal: Su Qin, Zhi Bo wisdom, not insufficient avoid humiliation far die, yet what die, confused by greedy profit not stop.
translations.idiomatic: Su Qin and Zhi Bo's wisdom was not insufficient to avoid humiliation and far death, yet the reason they died was confusion from greedy profit without stopping.

sentences.zh: 是以聖人制禮節欲，取於民有度，使之以時，用之有止，故志不溢，行不驕，常與道俱而不失，故天下承而不絕。

translations.literal: Thus, sage establish ritual section desires, take from people have measure, make with time, use have limit, thus will not overflow, conduct not arrogant, constantly with way together not lose, thus world receive not cease.
translations.idiomatic: Thus, the sage establishes ritual to regulate desire. He takes from the people in measured amounts, has them use resources at the proper times, and sets limits on expenditure. In this way ambitions do not overflow, conduct does not become arrogant, and the state remains constantly aligned with the Way without losing it. Thus, the world receives and continues without interruption.

sentences.zh: 昔者齊桓公九合諸侯，一匡天下，至於葵丘之會，有驕矜之志，畔者九國。

translations.literal: Formerly Qi Huan Gong nine unite feudal lords, one correct world, to Kui Qiu meeting, had arrogant proud will, rebel nine states.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Duke Huan of Qi nine times united the feudal lords, once corrected the world, to the Kui Qiu meeting, had arrogant proud will, rebels nine states.

sentences.zh: 吳王夫差兵無敵於天下，勇彊以輕諸侯，陵齊晉，故遂以殺身亡國。

translations.literal: Wu Wang Fu Cha troops no enemy world, brave strong with slight feudal lords, overbear Qi Jin, thus finally with kill body perish state.
translations.idiomatic: King Fu Chai of Wu had troops unmatched in the world, brave strong and slighted the feudal lords, overbore Qi and Jin, thus finally with killing the body perished the state.

sentences.zh: 夏育、太史噭叱呼駭三軍，然而身死於庸夫。

translations.literal: Xia Yu, Tai Shi Hao shout call fright three armies, however body die at common fellow.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Yu and Taishi Jiao could shout and terrify the three armies, yet they died at the hands of common men.

sentences.zh: 此皆乘至盛而不返道理，不居卑退處儉約之患也。

translations.literal: These all rode extreme flourishing not return reason, not dwell humble retreat place frugal thrift calamity.
translations.idiomatic: All these men rode the height of flourishing power and did not return to the proper course; they failed to dwell humbly, withdraw, and live frugally, and so met calamity.

sentences.zh: 夫商君為秦孝公明法令，禁姦本，尊爵必賞，有罪必罰，平權衡，正度量，調輕重，決裂阡陌，以靜生民之業而一其俗，勸民耕農利土，一室無二事，力田稸積，習戰陳之事，是以兵動而地廣，兵休而國富，故秦無敵於天下，立威諸侯，成秦國之業。

translations.literal: Shang Jun for Qin Xiao Gong clarified law commands, prohibited adultery root, honored rank certainly rewarded, have crime certainly punished, leveled balances, corrected measures, adjusted light heavy, broke open paths, to quiet give birth people enterprise unify custom, encouraged people plow farm profit soil, one room no two matters, exerted field stored grain, practiced battle array matters, thus troops move land broad, troops rest state rich, thus Qin no enemy world, established might feudal lords, completed Qin state enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Shang, serving Duke Xiao of Qin, clarified laws and commands, rooted out treachery, honored rank and made rewards certain, punished offenses without fail, standardized weights and measures, adjusted prices, and opened up the field paths. He settled the people's livelihood and unified their customs. He encouraged them to plow and farm for the profit of the land, kept each household to a single occupation, had them labor in the fields and store grain, and trained them in battle formations. Therefore, when the army moved, Qin's territory expanded; when the army rested, the state became rich. Thus, Qin had no match under heaven, established its power among the feudal lords, and completed the enterprise of the Qin state.

sentences.zh: 功已成矣，而遂以車裂。

translations.literal: Merit already complete, yet finally cart torn apart.
translations.idiomatic: His achievement was complete, yet in the end he was torn apart by chariots.

sentences.zh: 楚地方數千里，持戟百萬，白起率數萬之師以與楚戰，一戰舉鄢郢以燒夷陵，再戰南并蜀漢。

translations.literal: Chu territory several thousand li, held spears a million, Bai Qi led several ten thousand troops to battle Chu, one battle took Yan Ying burned Yi Ling, second battle south annexed Shu Han.
translations.idiomatic: Chu's territory measured several thousand li, and it had a million spearmen, yet Bai Qi led several tens of thousands of troops against Chu. In one battle he took Yan and Ying and burned Yiling; in a second battle he annexed Shu and Han in the south.

sentences.zh: 又越韓、魏而攻彊趙，北阬馬服，誅屠四十餘萬之眾，盡之于長平之下，流血成川，沸聲若雷，遂入圍邯鄲，使秦有帝業。

translations.literal: Again cross Han, Wei attack strong Zhao, north pit Ma Fu, execute slaughter forty plus ten thousand crowd, exhaust at Chang Ping below, flow blood become river, boil sound like thunder, then entered surround Handan, make Qin have imperial enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Again Qin crossed Han and Wei to attack powerful Zhao. In the north it buried Ma Fu's forces, slaughtering more than 400,000 men and annihilating them below Changping. Blood flowed into rivers, and the roar sounded like thunder. Qin then advanced to besiege Handan, giving Qin the foundation for imperial rule.

sentences.zh: 楚、趙天下之彊國而秦之仇敵也，自是之後，楚、趙皆懾伏不敢攻秦者，白起之勢也。

translations.literal: Chu, Zhao world strong states yet Qin enemy, from this after, Chu, Zhao all awed submit dare not attack Qin, Bai Qi might.
translations.idiomatic: Chu and Zhao were strong states under heaven and enemies of Qin, yet from this time on both were overawed and submitted, not daring to attack Qin. This was Bai Qi's power.

sentences.zh: 身所服者七十餘城，功已成矣，而遂賜劍死於杜郵。

translations.literal: Body what subdue seventy plus cities, merit already complete, yet finally grant sword die at Du You.
translations.idiomatic: He personally subdued more than seventy cities; his achievement was complete, yet in the end he was granted a sword and died at Duyou.

sentences.zh: 吳起為楚悼王立法，卑減大臣之威重，罷無能，廢無用，損不急之官，塞私門之請，一楚國之俗，禁游客之民，精耕戰之士，南收楊越，北并陳、蔡，破橫散從，使馳說之士無所開其口，禁朋黨以勵百姓，定楚國之政，兵震天下，威服諸侯。

translations.literal: Wu Qi for Chu Dao Wang established law, humbled reduced ministers authority heavy, dismissed no ability, abolished no use, reduced not urgent officials, blocked private gate requests, unified Chu state custom, prohibited traveler people, refined plow battle scholars, south collected Yang Yue, north combined Chen, Cai, broke horizontal scattered vertical, made gallop persuade scholars none open mouth, prohibited cliques encourage hundred surnames, settled Chu state politics, troops shook world, might subdued feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Qi, serving King Dao of Chu, established laws, humbled and reduced the weighty authority of ministers, dismissed the incompetent, abolished useless posts, cut offices that were not urgent, blocked petitions through private gates, unified the customs of Chu, restrained wandering retainers, and refined the men skilled in farming and war. To the south he took Yangyue; to the north he annexed Chen and Cai. He broke the horizontal alliances and scattered the vertical ones, leaving the itinerant persuaders with no opening for their mouths. He prohibited cliques, encouraged the common people, settled Chu's government, shook the world with his armies, and subdued the feudal lords by his might.

sentences.zh: 功已成矣，而卒枝解。

translations.literal: Merit already complete, yet finally branch torn apart.
translations.idiomatic: His achievement was complete, yet in the end he was torn limb from limb.

sentences.zh: 大夫種為越王深謀遠計，免會稽之危，以亡為存，因辱為榮，墾草入邑，辟地殖穀，率四方之士，專上下之力，輔句踐之賢，報夫差之讎，卒擒勁吳。

translations.literal: Da Fu Zhong for Yue Wang deep plan far strategy, avoided Kuaiji danger, with perish as preserve, because humiliation as honor, cleared grass entered city, opened land planted grain, led four directions scholars, monopolized up down strength, assisted Gou Jian worthy, reported Fu Cha enmity, finally captured strong Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Grandee Zhong formed deep and far-reaching plans for the King of Yue, saved him from the peril of Kuaiji, turned near-destruction into survival and humiliation into glory, cleared wasteland and populated cities, opened land and planted grain, gathered men from the four quarters, concentrated the strength of high and low, assisted Goujian's worthiness, avenged him against Fuchai, and finally captured mighty Wu.

sentences.zh: 令越成霸。

translations.literal: Made Yue complete hegemon.
translations.idiomatic: He made Yue a hegemon.

sentences.zh: 功已彰而信矣，句踐終負而殺之。

translations.literal: Merit already manifest trust, Gou Jian finally turn against kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Once his merit was manifest and his trust established, Goujian in the end betrayed and killed him.

sentences.zh: 此四子者，功成不去，禍至於此。

translations.literal: These four persons, merit complete not go, calamity arrive this.
translations.idiomatic: These four men completed their achievements but did not withdraw, and their calamities reached this point.

sentences.zh: 此所謂信而不能詘，往而不能返者也。

translations.literal: This called believe yet cannot yield, go yet cannot self return.
translations.idiomatic: This is what is meant by extending oneself but being unable to bend, going forward but being unable to return.

sentences.zh: 范蠡知之，超然辟世，長為陶朱公。

translations.literal: Fan Li knew, transcend leave world, long as Tao Zhu Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Li knew this, transcendently left the world, long as Tao Zhu Gong.

sentences.zh: 君獨不觀夫博者乎？

translations.literal: Jun alone not observe gambler?
translations.idiomatic: Your Lordship alone does not observe the gambler?

sentences.zh: 或欲大投，或欲分功，此皆君之所明知也。

translations.literal: Or wish big bet, or wish divide merit, this all jun what enlightened know.
translations.idiomatic: Some wish to make a great gamble; others wish to divide the credit. Your Lordship clearly knows all this.

sentences.zh: 今君相秦，計不下席，謀不出廊廟，坐制諸侯，利施三川，以實宜陽，決羊腸之險，塞太行之道，又斬范、中行之涂，六國不得合從，棧道千里，通於蜀漢，使天下皆畏秦，秦之欲得矣，君之功極矣，此亦秦之分功之時也。

translations.literal: Now jun chancellor Qin, plan not descend mat, strategy not out hall temple, sit control feudal lords, benefit extend three rivers, to fill Yi Yang, decide Yang Chang danger, block Taihang way, again cut Fan, Zhong Xing road, six states not able unite vertical, stack path thousand li, through Shu Han, make world all fear Qin, Qin desire got, jun merit extreme, this also Qin divide merit time.
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Lordship serves as chancellor of Qin. Your plans need not leave your mat, and your strategies need not go beyond the court, yet sitting still you control the feudal lords. Your benefits extend to Sanchuan, fill Yiyang, open the dangers of Yangchang, block the Taihang road, and cut off the routes of Fan and Zhonghang, so that the six states cannot unite in a vertical alliance. The plank road extends a thousand li and connects with Shu and Hanzhong, making the whole world fear Qin. Qin has obtained what it desired, and Your Lordship's merit is complete. This is also the time for Qin to distribute rewards for merit.

sentences.zh: 如是而不退，則商君、白公、吳起、大夫種是也。

translations.literal: Like this not retreat, then Shang Jun, Bai Qi, Wu Qi, Da Fu Zhong is.
translations.idiomatic: Like this and not retreat, then Shang Jun, Bai Qi, Wu Qi, Da Fu Zhong are it.

sentences.zh: 吾聞之，『鑒於水者見面之容，鑒於人者知吉與凶』。

translations.literal: I heard, 'mirror water see face appearance, mirror person know auspicious misfortune'.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard, 'mirror in water sees face's appearance, mirror in person knows auspicious and inauspicious'.

sentences.zh: 書曰『成功之下，不可久處』。

translations.literal: Book say 'success below, cannot long dwell'.
translations.idiomatic: The Book says 'below success, cannot long dwell'.

sentences.zh: 四子之禍，君何居焉？

translations.literal: Four persons calamity, jun what dwell?
translations.idiomatic: Four persons' calamity, Your Lordship what dwells?

sentences.zh: 君何不以此時歸相印，讓賢者而授之，退而巖居川觀，必有伯夷之廉，長為應侯。

translations.literal: Jun why not at this time return chancellor seal, yield worthy grant it, retreat dwell rocks observe rivers, must have Bo Yi purity, long as Ying Hou.
translations.idiomatic: Your Lordship why not at this time return the chancellor seal, yield to worthy ones and grant it, retreat and dwell in rocks observe rivers, must have Bo Yi's purity, long as Ying Hou.

sentences.zh: 世世稱孤，而有許由、延陵季子之讓，喬松之壽，孰與以禍終哉？

translations.literal: Generations praise orphan, have Xu You, Yanling jizi yield, Qiao Song longevity, who with calamity end?
translations.idiomatic: Generations praise the orphan, having Xu You, Yanling jizi's yielding, Qiao Song's longevity, who compares with ending in calamity?

sentences.zh: 即君何居焉？

translations.literal: Then jun what dwell?
translations.idiomatic: Then Your Lordship what dwells?

sentences.zh: 忍不能自離，疑不能自決，必有四子之禍矣。

translations.literal: Bear cannot self separate, doubt cannot self decide, certainly have four persons calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Bearing cannot self separate, doubting cannot self decide, certainly have four persons' calamity.

sentences.zh: 《易》曰『亢龍有悔』，此言上而不能下，信而不能詘，往而不能自返者也。

translations.literal: Yi said 'high dragon have regret', this speak ascend cannot descend, believe cannot yield, go cannot self return.
translations.idiomatic: The Yi says 'high dragon has regret', this speaks of ascending cannot descend, believing cannot yield, going cannot self return.

sentences.zh: 願君孰計之！」

translations.literal: Wish jun carefully consider!'
translations.idiomatic: Wish Your Lordship carefully consider it!'

sentences.zh: 應侯曰：「善。

translations.literal: Ying Hou said: 'Good.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ying said: 'Good.

sentences.zh: 吾聞『欲而不知（止）［足］，失其所以欲；

translations.literal: I heard 'desire yet not know sufficiency, lose what desire;
translations.idiomatic: I have heard 'desiring yet not knowing sufficiency, lose what one desires;'

sentences.zh: 有而不知（足）［止］，失其所以有』。

translations.literal: Having something but not knowing when to stop is to lose what one has.
translations.idiomatic: To possess something without knowing when to stop is to lose the very thing one possesses.

sentences.zh: 先生幸教，睢敬受命。』

translations.literal: Master has graciously instructed me; I, Sui, respectfully receive your command.
translations.idiomatic: Master, you have graciously instructed me. I, Sui, respectfully accept your command.

sentences.zh: 於是乃延入坐，為上客。

translations.literal: Thereupon he invited him in, seated him, and treated him as an honored guest.
translations.idiomatic: He then invited Cai Ze in, seated him, and treated him as a guest of the highest rank.

sentences.zh: 後數日，入朝，言於秦昭王曰：「客新有從山東來者曰蔡澤，其人辯士，明於三王之事，五伯之業，世俗之變，足以寄秦國之政。

translations.literal: Several days later, he entered court and said to King Zhao of Qin, "A guest has newly come from east of the mountains, named Cai Ze. He is an eloquent scholar, clear about the affairs of the Three Kings, the achievements of the Five Hegemons, and the changes of common custom, enough to entrust with Qin's government.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later, Lord Ying went to court and told King Zhao of Qin, "A man named Cai Ze has recently arrived from east of the mountains. He is an eloquent scholar, versed in the affairs of the Three Kings, the achievements of the Five Hegemons, and the transformations of the age; he is capable of being entrusted with Qin's government.

sentences.zh: 臣之見人甚眾，莫及，臣不如也。

translations.literal: I have seen very many people; none reaches him, and I am not his equal.
translations.idiomatic: I have met many men, but none equals him. I am no match for him.

sentences.zh: 臣敢以聞。」

translations.literal: I dare to report this."
translations.idiomatic: I venture to report this to Your Majesty."

sentences.zh: 秦昭王召見，與語，大說之，拜為客卿。

translations.literal: King Zhao of Qin summoned him for an audience, spoke with him, was greatly pleased by him, and appointed him guest minister.
translations.idiomatic: King Zhao of Qin summoned Cai Ze, spoke with him, was delighted, and appointed him guest minister.

sentences.zh: 應侯因謝病請歸相印。

translations.literal: Lord Ying then pleaded illness and requested to return the chancellor's seal.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Ying then claimed illness and asked to return the chancellor's seal.

sentences.zh: 昭王彊起應侯，應侯遂稱病甐。

translations.literal: Zhao Wang strong raised Ying Hou, Ying Hou thus claimed illness lying down.
translations.idiomatic: King Zhao strongly raised Lord Ying, Lord Ying thus claimed illness and lay down.

sentences.zh: 范睢免相，昭王新說蔡澤計畫，遂拜為秦相，東收周室。

translations.literal: Fan Sui dismissed chancellor, Zhao Wang newly pleased Cai Ze plans, then appointed as Qin chancellor, east took Zhou room.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Sui was dismissed as chancellor; King Zhao was newly pleased with Cai Ze's plans and appointed him Qin chancellor, and he took in the Zhou royal house from the east.

sentences.zh: 蔡澤相秦數月，人或惡之，懼誅，乃謝病歸相印，號為綱成君。

translations.literal: Cai Ze chancellor Qin several months, people or hated him, feared execute, then thanked illness return chancellor seal, number as Gang Cheng Jun.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ze was chancellor of Qin for several months; some slandered him, and fearing execution he claimed illness, returned the chancellor's seal, and was styled Lord Gangcheng.

sentences.zh: 居秦十餘年，事昭王、孝文王、莊襄王。

translations.literal: Dwelt Qin ten plus years, served Zhao Wang, Xiao Wen Wang, Zhuang Xiang Wang.
translations.idiomatic: He dwelt in Qin for more than ten years, serving Kings Zhao, Xiaowen, and Zhuangxiang.

sentences.zh: 卒事始皇帝，為秦使於燕，三年而燕使太子丹入質於秦。

translations.literal: Finally served Shi Huang Di, as Qin envoy to Yan, three years Yan made crown prince Dan enter hostage Qin.
translations.idiomatic: He finally served the First Emperor, and as Qin envoy to Yan, after three years Yan sent Crown Prince Dan as hostage to Qin.

sentences.zh: 太史公曰：韓子稱「長袖善舞，多錢善賈」，信哉是言也！

translations.literal: The Grand Historian said: Han Feizi said, "Long sleeves are good for dancing; much money is good for trading"; how true these words are!
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Historian said: Han Feizi wrote, "Long sleeves make for graceful dancing; ample money makes for good trading." How true that saying is!

sentences.zh: 范睢、蔡澤世所謂一切辯士，然游說諸侯至白首無所遇者，非計策之拙，所為說力少也。

translations.literal: Fan Sui and Cai Ze were what the world calls versatile persuaders, yet those who roamed persuading the feudal lords until white-haired old age without meeting opportunity did not lack plans; the force behind what they advocated was small.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Sui and Cai Ze were the kind of adaptable persuaders praised by the age. Yet men who spent their lives roaming among the lords and grew old without finding opportunity were not necessarily poor strategists; often the power behind their proposals was simply too slight.

sentences.zh: 及二人羈旅入秦，繼踵取卿相，垂功於天下者，固彊弱之勢異也。

translations.literal: When these two men came as travelers into Qin and one after another obtained ministerial and chancellorial rank, leaving achievements to the world, it was certainly because the balance of strong and weak was different.
translations.idiomatic: When these two came to Qin as wandering guests and quickly rose to ministerial and chancellorial rank, leaving achievements known throughout the world, it was because the balance of strength had changed.

sentences.zh: 然士亦有偶合，賢者多如此二子，不得盡意，豈可勝道哉！

translations.literal: Yet scholars also have chance alignments; many worthy men were like these two but could not fully realize their intentions. How could they all be recounted!
translations.idiomatic: Yet scholars also depend on fortunate conjunctions. Many worthy men resembled these two but never fully realized their intentions. How could they all be named!

sentences.zh: 然二子不困緦惡能激乎？

translations.literal: However, two persons not trapped distress how able stimulate?
translations.idiomatic: However, if these two gentlemen were not trapped in distress, how could they be stimulated?
